            return z

import pylab
from mpmath import mp, fp

results = []
for ctx_name, ctx in [("mp", mp), ("fp", fp)]:
    for points in [8, 9]:
        evaluated = []
        f = lambda z: (evaluated.append(z), z)[1]
        fig = pylab.figure()
        ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
        ctx.cplot(f, points=points, axes=ax)
        grid_shape = ax.images[0].get_array().shape
        num_evals = len(evaluated)
        results.append((num_evals, grid_shape[0], grid_shape[1]))
        probe(f"{ctx_name}_p{points}_evals", num_evals)
        probe(f"{ctx_name}_p{points}_rows", grid_shape[0])
        probe(f"{ctx_name}_p{points}_cols", grid_shape[1])
        pylab.close(fig)
